name: Delhi crash-prone zones 2024 — all named locations with approximate coordinates

metadata.source: Delhi Road Crash Report 2024, Delhi Traffic Police
metadata.coordinate_policy: Approximate centres of named landmarks, intersections, transport hubs, neighbourhoods or closest interpretable areas.
metadata.important_warning: The report states that crash spots were geotagged internally but does not publish their coordinates. These coordinates are approximate and are not official police geotags.
metadata.completeness_note: The report states 111 crash-prone zones, but its visible main table names 88. Five additional named locations appear in category tables, yielding 93 unique named locations.
